what: Freedom Holding is a brokerage and bank built around Kazakhstan and Central Asia. It runs retail brokerage, banking, insurance and an ecosystem of consumer apps, and is listed in the United States.
customers: Retail investors and banking customers in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and neighbouring countries.
money: commissions and interest from retail trading accounts
moat: A dominant retail brokerage position in Kazakhstan combined with a bank and an app ecosystem, in markets where financial services are still being built out.
risks: 58 times earnings and $1.2B of negative free cash flow
Regulatory scrutiny in the United States over its Russian-linked business has been a recurring issue
Concentrated in Kazakhstan, so the country's economy and currency drive results
opportunities: Revenue grew from $690M to $2.2B in four years
$966M of cash against $49M of debt at the holding level
Central Asian retail investing and digital banking are growing from a very low base
watch: Brokerage account growth and any regulatory developments in the United States.
